context:
Goal: the merge tool backs off when the GitHub quota runs low, and never merges under a running batch.
Problem (rule): your grant 789 a covers one fix: serve any armed hold before the batch-brake read and arm none from there through the merge call. The fresh review of head 361faeb3e found a second spot: a hold is still served after the base fetch (records_proof, holds_base) and before the batch-brake read, so up to 900 s can pass between the base fetch and the merge call. A push to the base in that pause is not flagged, because strict is false. The lane's fix serves the hold before the base fetch and keeps holds off from there through the merge call. Your ruling covers the named act, never a variant, so the lane waits on this part (rule outcomes-grant-covers-named-act).
Based on (read): the lane's report and the fresh review, per the lane (unchecked by triage); ruling own-789-a-round-5-one-fix, read in full by triage; no past ruling covers moving the serve point earlier.
Departs from: main — main sends the merge call right after the base fetch with no wait; this branch can pause first. a changes the branch once more (a second fix beyond the three-round cap), b leaves the gap as a debt, c parks the PR.
Meanwhile: the lane fixes finding 1 (a test double lacks the new seams; a test fix, no new grant needed) and holds finding 2.
lastAnswer: 794: c, Park the PR, at 20:09 CST Nov 13.
